name: studio-macro
summary: Photoreal macro product shots: brushed metal and woven fabric under soft studio light, shallow focus, dark backdrop.

metal.note: roughness map only, never its normal map (it is diamond plate)

fabric.note: diffuse as greyscale detail; colour comes from the palette

xray.note: use for cutaways instead of boolean slices

rules: one shot every 2-3 s, hard cuts between shots
the camera is never still: slow push or drift during every hold
every move starts on the word that names it

story: real-world moment in the first second
scale dive to the hidden mechanism
interactive beat (ask the viewer to check something)
loop back to the first frame
source: Built for Code Kinnu's own zipper Short. Not copied from any channel.
